issues.title: Tidy build process
issues.body:
When I run `yarn dev` two browser tabs open, the one for `localhost:8080` is broken.

Can we do some general tidying to the `yarn dev` build script to double-check the steps in the build sequence are valid, and that just one tab opens, please.

It also looks like the build completes, updates the tab in the browser, then another build process kicks off.
